title: Mixed Event — You deserve it! Break Time! — Episode1 For The Fans

meta.Event Outline: As the livestreaming gains momentum, Haruka endeavors to create new content to keep viewers engaged. Balancing daily practice, training, school studies, and idol activities, Haruka devotes herself without a moment's rest, causing Shizuku to worry.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Alright, shall we move to our next segment?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That segment is kind of a tradition now, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, it kind of is!
You're up, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our next segment is... “Let's Learn to Dance with Minori!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: For all of you that want to learn how to dance like idols, I'm here to teach you some tips and tricks behind copying certain dance moves!

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Alright!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<What's today's song?>
<What's gonna happen today...?>
<Play something good!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, we're already getting requests.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
How about we dance to that song we worked on last time?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Yeah! Do that!>
<Show us the way, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You got it! I'll talk about some key points while we dance, so let's get started!
song00004_off_f

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Great work today, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Your segment went really well today, Minori. You've gotten so much better at giving tips too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I had so much trouble saying things in a way that was easy to understand before...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But Haruka really helped me with how to give our viewers advice that they can digest quickly!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't realize.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I see.
It makes sense if Haruka was the one giving you advice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I really didn't say much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You picked up everything so fast, Minori. I'm sure you'll just keep getting better and better.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll be looking forward to that, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'll try my best...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's up, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's just...
I feel like some of the things we're doing are starting to go stale...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori's segment from today and even some of the other ideas that we followed up on did grow our viewership...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: At the same time, people have been complaining about us not coming up with anything new...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Something new...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll try thinking up some ideas!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's not my strong suit, but I'll do what I can as well...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you.
I'll do the same.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We have to keep trying so that our viewers keep on smiling.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's already this late...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Practice after the stream went on longer than I expected. We should all head home and try to relax.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. We can all get some well-deserved rest and see each other again tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then I'll see you tomorrow...
Um... H-Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka Fan
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me!
I've been a huge fan for a really long time! Would it be okay if we shake hands...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Have we met before? I believe at a meet and greet...

rows.Speaker: Haruka Fan
rows.Line: What?! Y-You remember me...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I do. You're the one that always gave me those nice letters, right? Of course I remember.

rows.Speaker: Haruka Fan
rows.Line: I don't know what to say... Thank you so much! I can't believe that you actually remembered who I was...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I've always appreciated your support. I'll be counting on you in the future too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sure you already know, but I'm in a group called MORE MORE JUMP! now. We'll be counting on your support as a group too, so I hope you'll stay tuned in.

rows.Speaker: Haruka Fan
rows.Line: Yes, I do. I've been watching your videos!

rows.Speaker: Haruka Fan
rows.Line: I love how we get to see a part of you that we didn't get to see on TV, Haruka...! I'm really looking forward to seeing more!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haruka's so amazing...!
She's having an actual conversation with someone that just randomly came up to her...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, she really is something else. It has to be pretty hard to remember everyone's names too considering how many ASRUN fans there are.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A professional through and through.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're really the best of the best, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, huh? What's gotten into you, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She couldn't believe how you handled that fan just now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You made them so happy too.
You really are quite amazing, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Haha. Thanks.
But I feel a little embarrassed now that I know you were all watching...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!!
I want to learn how to do what you just did back there!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That just means you have to keep trying more and more, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... I will...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Just don't push yourself too hard, okay?
Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Okay, that's enough training for now...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(It's already 10:00 pm...
Practice did run a little late I guess...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I need to finish up my homework, think of some ideas for our videos and...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Going in this direction should work for now, but we also may want to start thinking about more long-term solutions soon...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (More people have begun commenting during our livestreams and it is pretty apparent that they'd like to see us try new things.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But what should we do and how...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This won't be easy. Nobody on ASRUN was responsible for coming up with ideas like this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka Fan
rows.Line: I love how we get to see a part of you that we didn't get to see on TV, Haruka...! I'm really looking forward to seeing more!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's hardly easy and it's a lot of work... But it really is fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, let's come up with some new ideas. I still have a little bit of time...
